families.title: Probabilistic programs: Dice, Alea.jl, Roulette and further systems
families.intro: The programs of the Dice, Alea.jl, Roulette and Geni papers, against Dice, Alea.jl and Roulette, and on the programs they take Geni, noDice, Psi, Genfer, SPPL, Pluck, WebPPL, PITA, aspmc, Scallop, PSouffle, Storm, PRISM, Ace, Merlin, pyAgrum, pgmpy, libDAI and TensorInference.jl. tddlog runs its own encoding of a program's integers (binary, never one-hot) and is asked what the baseline answers: single marginals where the baseline gives single marginals, a distribution's values only where it computes them. Alea.jl's and Pluck's times leave out Julia's start-up and compilation, as Alea.jl's papers time it; the dashed lines add them to Alea.jl's, and Racket's start-up to Roulette's.

paras: tddlog's answers agree with the references everywhere, to 2e-1 relative against Alea.jl and exact references and to 3e-8 against ProbLog's eight printed digits. ProbLog's d-DNNF is wrong on four bit-blasted circuits (clickGraph at 14 bits, by 0.016, pi at 12 bits, by 0.17, wmi_star at None bits, by 0.00022 and wmi_star at None bits, by 6.3e-05), which Ganak's exact count confirms. Dice prints 0 for every answer on 15 bit-blasted circuits, and Alea.jl's discretization is defective in the far tails of a normal, which moves the gene expression program's answer at Figure 2's precision from 1/2 to 0.333 with 5 genes and 0.482 with 20, where the artifact's own runs give 0.4999995 at every number of genes.

suites.title: The Dice paper's programs
suites.about: The programs and Bayesian networks of the Dice paper (Holtzen, Van den Broeck and Millstein, OOPSLA 2020), a network as one Dice program per queried variable, and its loop programs scaled up. tddlog runs them translated to ProbLog, Alea.jl translated to Julia, Roulette translated to Racket. 300 s a run (600 s on the loop programs). Roulette+tddlog runs Roulette's program as Roulette does, up to the formulas of its queries, and hands them to tddlog; its time is Roulette's up to there and tddlog's. Geni, noDice, Psi, Genfer, SPPL, Pluck, WebPPL, PITA, aspmc, Scallop, Storm, PRISM, Ace, Merlin, pyAgrum, pgmpy, libDAI and TensorInference.jl ran too, each on the programs it takes (its own paper's, the Dice programs, the ProbLog programs or the networks); a system's time is its process's, start-up included.

suites.title: Alea.jl's and noDice's programs
suites.about: Cao et al.'s integer arithmetic programs (UAI 2023), Pluck's sequence models (PLDI 2025) and noDice's purely probabilistic programs (OOPSLA 2026). Alea.jl runs an Alea.jl program itself; Alea.jl+tddlog runs it up to the Boolean circuit Alea.jl builds and hands that circuit to tddlog; tddlog and the other systems run ports of the program, and their readings of that circuit are the circuits'. The noDice programs are Dice programs, translated, and Roulette runs them translated to Racket. 600 s a run. Roulette+tddlog runs Roulette's program as Roulette does, up to the formulas of its queries, and hands them to tddlog; its time is Roulette's up to there and tddlog's. Alea.jl+tddlog runs Alea.jl's program of the diamond and the ladder as Alea.jl does, up to the circuit it exports, and hands it to tddlog; its time is Alea.jl's up to there, warm, and tddlog's. Geni, noDice, Psi, Genfer, SPPL, Pluck, WebPPL, PITA, aspmc, Scallop, Storm, PRISM, Ace, Merlin, pyAgrum, pgmpy, libDAI and TensorInference.jl ran too, each on the programs it takes (its own paper's, the Dice programs, the ProbLog programs or the networks); a system's time is its process's, start-up included.

suites.title: Circulette's netlists
suites.about: The digital circuits of [Circulette](https://github.com/sandialabs/circulette), a language on Roulette for the fault analysis of circuits: its netlists, and a ripple-carry adder and a multiply-accumulate unit at growing widths. Each gate fails with probability 0.01; given wrong outputs, Circulette asks the posterior of each set of up to three failed gates. Roulette runs Circulette's circulette.rkt; tddlog reads the netlist itself, and ProbLog and the systems beside it the ProbLog program `tddlog --program` writes of it, timed with that conversion. Roulette+tddlog runs circulette.rkt up to the formulas of its queries and hands them to tddlog through Roulette's [tddlog engine](https://github.com/Tractables/roulette/tree/tddlog). 600 s a run. PITA, aspmc, Scallop, PSouffle, Ace, Merlin, pyAgrum, pgmpy, libDAI and TensorInference.jl ran too, on the program `tddlog --program` writes of the netlist; a system's time is its process's, start-up included.
